title: Meet Bitrig Remote for iPhone Duo
summary: The 3D simulator, your code, and your App Store listing, side by side with your agent. For the first time, the full Bitrig experience fits in your pocket.
body_markdown:
iPhone Duo arrives in two days. If you’re one of the lucky people getting one,[Bitrig Remote](https://bitrig.com/remote) will be ready for you to play with on day one.


We took this opportunity to redesign Bitrig Remote. It now has all the tabs you’re used to from Bitrig Mac—the 3D simulator, code, and App Store listing—and when you unfold the Duo, they sit side by side with your agent.


You can:


-


**Run your app in the 3D simulator.** Remote shows every device model your Mac does, including both of iPhone Duo’s displays. Drag to turn it, or use the toolbar to fold and flip it. It streams at up to 60 fps and stays smoother even on a weaker connection.


-


**Publish to the App Store.** Update your listing, see your product page on iPhone or iPad before it’s live, and submit your build for review.


-


**Review your code.** Browse your project’s files and diffs, open any file your agent links to, and tap a diff line to comment on it.


If you’re new to Bitrig Remote, it[connects to Bitrig running on your Mac](https://bitrig.com/blog/meet-bitrig-remote) , turning your iPhone into a[professional app development environment](https://bitrig.com/blog/meet-bitrig-remote-for-ipad) . Build with frontier AI agents like Claude Code and Codex, the full Xcode toolchain, and the SDKs for all of Apple’s major platforms. Bring your existing Xcode projects and GitHub repositories, and[install your app right on your Home Screen](https://bitrig.com/blog/bitrig-remote-install-and-distribute-apps) with one tap.


Almost anything possible on Bitrig Mac, you can now do from Bitrig Remote. Change your agents’ permissions, add plugins and MCP servers, choose your simulators, and delete build artifacts taking up space on your Mac. For the first time, the full Bitrig experience fits in your pocket.


With your Duo closed, make quick edits on the go. When you’re ready for an extended working session, unfold it, and your whole workspace opens up in a layout optimized for the inner display.
